concept.title: Understanding usage logs
concept.shortdesc: By default, Red Hat Quay stores usage logs in its database and shows them in the web UI. You can query those logs in PostgreSQL and map action types by kind_id.

conbody.p: Usage logs appear at the organization and repository levels, and in the Superuser Admin Panel. Database logs capture a wide range of events in Red Hat Quay, such as account plan changes, user actions, and general operations. Log entries include information such as the action performed (kind_id), the user who performed the action (account_id or performer_id), the timestamp (datetime), and other relevant data associated with the action (metadata_json).
